tasks.title: Core game logic: rng, 12 species with 4 colourways + 2 rare part mods, hatch + rarity + pity, Spark + daily cap, eggs, growth + branching, care + streak, regions, tests
SVG pet renderer for every species/part/colourway/stage/branch/mood
Screens: Home (buddy, care, egg meter, today), hatch, focus timer, Pets, pet detail + rename + buddy, Dex, Settings
Step counting via expo-sensors Pedometer, denied state with Open Settings; original icon + splash

Home-screen widgets (iOS WidgetKit target via @bacons/apple-targets like apps/glaze, added in eas-build-post-install; production-native profile): small = buddy + mood + egg meter, medium = + today's Spark + Feed/Pet buttons (AppIntents, iOS 17+). App writes buddy pose PNGs + state to the App Group on each change and calls reloadAllTimelines. Each widget instance can pick its pet (configurable intent). Fail soft without the native module.
Pre-render pet poses to PNG for widgets (react-native-view-shot or Skia offscreen) and cache by pet+stage+mood
First-run onboarding: 3 short cards (walk = Spark, eggs hatch pets, pets grow into forms) then the starter egg; asks for Motion permission with a plain reason
Hatch polish: egg wiggles on its own, crack particles, rarity-coloured burst for Rare+, sound off by default; Reduce Motion path
HealthKit adapter (sleep, workouts, mindful minutes) behind src/native/health.ts; sleep -> Dreamy branch XP, workouts -> Strong; add those branches to species art
Release kit: docs/privacy.html, docs/support.html, docs/STORE.md (no competitor names), store/ screenshots kit, docs/RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md
Add Roamlings to marketing/apps.json as stage building (name not locked)
Pet journal on the detail screen (hatched where/when, evolutions, renames) and a gentle 'buddy says' line on Home based on trait + mood
More species: 12 regional species (2 per region) gated by state.region, plus a weekly 'visitor' species rotation (deterministic from the ISO week)
Server + accounts (needs Jared's OK for a free Supabase or Cloudflare account): age gate, server-side hatch rolls from seed, pet ledger, Spark caps, sync
Friends + trading: QR/bump add, bump + remote trades as single server transactions, gifts, preset reactions, block/report, trade-only evolutions
Family: parent account + dashboard, parent quests, friend/trade approvals, time and Spark limits
World: World Dex map, weather/time-of-day odds, seasonal events (both hemispheres), community goals
Depth: pairing, habitats, expeditions (widget countdown), races and shows, Live Activities
Launch prep: Plus / Family Plus (never sells randomness), cosmetics shop, privacy review, age ratings, store listing, Apple Watch
